seo.imageCaption: Enjoy this refreshing Cold Jellyfish Salad, a perfect blend of savory, tangy, and spicy flavors, making it an irresistible Chinese appetizer.

description: Cold Jellyfish Salad is a refreshing and classic Chinese appetizer, known for its unique chewy texture and vibrant flavors. This dish is typically dressed with a savory, tangy, and often spicy sauce, making it an irresistible start to any meal. Its crisp, cool nature provides a perfect contrast to richer main courses.

instructions.title: Prepare Jellyfish
instructions.text: Rinse the prepared jellyfish thoroughly under cold running water for several minutes to remove excess saltiness. Squeeze out any excess water and cut into bite-sized strips if not already shredded.

instructions.title: Prepare Vegetables
instructions.text: Wash the cucumber and julienne it into thin strips. Mince the garlic cloves finely.

instructions.title: Make the Dressing
instructions.text: In a small bowl, combine the soy sauce, black vinegar, sesame oil, and sugar. Whisk well until the sugar dissolves and all ingredients are thoroughly mixed. Add chili oil to your desired spice level and mix again.

instructions.title: Combine Ingredients
instructions.text: In a large mixing bowl, combine the rinsed jellyfish strips and the julienned cucumber.

instructions.title: Dress the Salad
instructions.text: Pour the prepared dressing over the jellyfish and cucumber mixture. Add the minced garlic.

instructions.title: Toss and Chill
instructions.text: Gently toss all ingredients together until the jellyfish and cucumber are evenly coated with the dressing. Cover the bowl and refrigerate for at least 30 minutes to allow the flavors to meld and the salad to chill thoroughly.

instructions.title: Serve and Garnish
instructions.text: Before serving, give the salad another gentle toss. Garnish with toasted sesame seeds and fresh chopped cilantro. Serve chilled as a refreshing Chinese appetizer.

tips: For the best texture, ensure the jellyfish is thoroughly rinsed and squeezed dry to remove excess brine.
Adjust the amount of chili oil and sugar to suit your personal preference for spiciness and sweetness.
This salad is best served well-chilled. Prepare it a few hours in advance to allow the flavors to fully develop in the refrigerator.
